question: The easternmost extension of the Himalayas does NOT include which of the following?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Khasi Hills**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Khasi Hills** are located in the northeastern state of **Meghalaya**, India.
 
• They are part of the **Meghalaya Plateau**, which is distinct from the Himalayas.
 
• The Khasi Hills consist of rolling hills and are well-known for their **lush green landscapes** and **rich biodiversity**.
 
• This region is famous for its **living root bridges**, an example of traditional ecological engineering.
 
• The Khasi Hills are primarily inhabited by the **Khasi tribal community**, who have a unique culture and language.
 
• Unlike the Naga, Patkai, and Mizo Hills, which are considered extensions of the eastern Himalayas, the Khasi Hills belong to the **Peninsular Block** and are geologically older.
 
• They do not share the tectonic or geographical characteristics associated with the Himalayan range.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Naga Hills**__

 __
 
• The **Naga Hills** are located in the northeastern states of **Nagaland** and **Manipur**.
 
• They form part of the **Arakan Yoma range**, which is considered an eastern extension of the Himalayas.
 
• The Naga Hills are known for their **rugged terrain** and dense forests.
 
• This region is inhabited by the **Naga tribes**, who have a rich cultural heritage.
 
 
 
• **Patkai Hills**__
 __
 
• The **Patkai Hills**, also known as the **Patkai Bum**, are located along the northeastern border of India, including parts of **Arunachal Pradesh** and **Nagaland**.
 
• They are part of the **Himalayan mountain system** and are known for their high rainfall and dense vegetation.
 
• The Patkai Hills act as a natural barrier between India and Myanmar.
 
 
 
• **Mizo Hills**__
 
 
• The **Mizo Hills**, also known as the **Lushai Hills**, are located in the northeastern state of **Mizoram**.
 
• They are considered part of the **easternmost extension of the Himalayas**.
 
• This region is known for its **undulating hills** and **rich flora and fauna**.
 
• The Mizo Hills are primarily inhabited by the **Mizo tribes**.
